Container.Name: flacjack
Container.Overview: FlacJack 🥞 — Fresh, warm stacks of lossless audio on demand. Self-hosted Hi-Fi lossless aggregator and BitChord module with smart lookahead queue prefetching and local SSD caching.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Port for BitChord module API and WebUI Dashboard

Config.Name: App Data Path
Config.Description: Location for database and local audio prefetch cache

Config.Name: Music Library Path
Config.Description: Location where archived FLAC tracks are saved (if archiving enabled)

Config.Name: Max Cache Size (GB)
Config.Description: Maximum SSD cache storage for audio prefetch

Config.Name: Prefetch Lookahead
Config.Description: Number of upcoming tracks to prefetch in background

Config.Name: Secret Token
Config.Description: Required for remote access. URL-safe, 16+ chars (openssl rand -hex 24). Module URL: https://HOST/s/TOKEN/bitchord-module.json

Config.Name: Enable WebUI
Config.Description: Enable the LAN-only dashboard (it displays your secret token)

Config.Name: Enable FLAC Archiving
Config.Description: Set to true to permanently archive all played tracks to /music
